newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus welcomes Spain soccer TV deal.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus welcomes Spain soccer TV deal.

text.p: French pay television firm Canal Plus welcomed on Friday an agreement to broadcast Spanish soccer reached between Spain's Sogecable media holding company, Spanish commercial channel Antena 3 and the TV3 Catalonian channel.
Canal Plus owns 25 percent of Sogecable.

The three partners will form a subsidiary to manage the joint use of broadcasting rights for first and second division matches, Canal Plus said in a statement. The pact "strengthens Sogecable's ranking as Spain's leading pay-television company and also enhances the Canal+ group's European position in the area of sports broadcasting rights," it said.
The move also gives an "advance" to the Spanish digital package Canalsatellite Digital, which will be launched in January, Canal Plus said.
The Spanish companies announced the soccer deal on Thursday.
